negative_pool: For each object and wording, use every count already in frozen quantity_text_order; positive is the user-confirmed actual count, all other cached counts are negatives. Preserve object-specific coverage.
score_precision: Primary frozen float32 similarities; float64 dot products provide independent numerical sensitivity check. No re-encoding or model changes.

formulas.mean_pair_accuracy: mean(s_positive > s_negative over cached wrong counts)

selectors.uniform: mean metrics over all four candidates; reference expectation
selectors.hard_total: argmax 0.2*quality + A hard margin (primary proposed selector)
selectors.hard_quality_first: restrict to quality_usable if any, then argmax A hard margin; fall back all four if no qualified candidate
selectors.B_oracle_quality_first: same quality restriction, maximize B hard margin; descriptive candidate-pool upper bound

deterministic_ties: lowest candidate seed; training ties lowest sample index. Original pair correctness and multi-negative top1 use strict >0.

cohorts.training8: original 8 training images; inspect reward mechanics
cohorts.confirmation55: remaining55 train images; primary confirmation count-macro uses52 with counts1..4

bootstrap.macro: equal weight counts1..4; resample images within each count
bootstrap.raw: equal image weight; resample image pairs

selection_analysis: All170 fixed-policy groups and32 on-policy training groups are replayed. B evaluations stay separate from A-based selector definitions. Training groups include policy versions and are descriptive only.
followup: If all recommendation gates pass, freeze matched32-update comparison design for pair and hard reward. Otherwise audit reward/state sensitivity on frozen features, choose the next offline intervention from observed failure and record a concrete plan. No automatic extension beyond this offline stage.
fact_review: Generated text semantic and counting accuracy remains [待确认]; scorer diagnostics describe frozen embedding discrimination.
